text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests, on the other hand, examine how different parts of the system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where tests are written before the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the program should do. Although writing tests takes extra time, it gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they know their changes have not broken anything important. In the long run, good testing saves time and leads to more reliable software.
